selection_rule: H1 arm opposes or mimics, unflagged for active moiety, seed-specific under the three IT10 nulls AND the reach-matched null (same sign, |z| > 3 in all four); H2 identity resolved in the catalogue (ChEMBL id) and modality small_molecule; H3 the arm has a stated benefit hypothesis in question_roles.tsv (arms whose own text says 'no sourced/stated' benefit hypothesis are kept in proposals, never handed over); H4 not decided in an IT9/IT10/IT11 qualification record (those are carried with their state, not re-proposed); H5 one proposal per mechanism cluster = (question, hypothesis, main target), chosen by number of evidence origins, then the shorter admissible chain (fewer edges), then the smallest |z|; salt twins count once; H6 at most 3 per (question, hypothesis); H7 a proposal whose only signed support at the main target is not a resolved assertion is not handed over (the signed pair must survive the refreshed guards, which is the case for every row of the refreshed table); H8 a mechanism cluster in which ANY member (eligible or not) has an IT9/IT10/IT11 qualification record is not handed over as new: it is listed in mechanism_clusters_it21.tsv with that record, because the earlier reason may have been about the compound and only the qualification can say so (unknown is not negative).
